name: Rene Dreyfus
features: olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, round friendly face, neat moustache, compact build, warm confident expression
bio: Winner of the 1930 Monaco Grand Prix in a privateer Bugatti, Dreyfus later took the 1938 Pau Grand Prix for Delahaye — beating the Mercedes W154 of Caracciola and Lang in a straight fight, the most celebrated French victory of the Silver Arrows era. Of Jewish descent, he emigrated to the United States in 1940 and never returned to live in France.
